description: This file defines routing mechanisms for a FastAPI application, including route creation, dependency management, WebSocket support, and inclusion of routers. It provides classes for individual route handling (APIRoute), WebSocket routes (APIRouter), and integration with Starlette's routing system. The file facilitates grouping and managing API endpoints with support for dependencies, response handling, custom route classes, and OpenAPI schema generation.

classes.name: APIWebSocketRoute
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket route, extending Starlette's WebSocketRoute, with dependency support and path matching.

classes.name: APIRoute
classes.description: Defines an API route with path, endpoint, response models, dependencies, and automatic request handling via a coroutine.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: A router class to group related API routes, supporting prefix, tags, dependencies, and inclusion of other routers and routes, with integration to Starlette's routing system.
